ayuda.general.cont:
Hardware component buying and selling system.

• Sign in with your username and password. Your role determines which menus you see.
• Menus are enabled by permissions. An administrator sees everything.
• You can change the language from User → Change language.
• Press F1 on any screen to see its help.
ayuda.login.cont: Enter your username and password. After 3 failed attempts the user is locked and an administrator must unlock it.
ayuda.roles.cont: Each user has a role (Administrator, Cashier, Purchasing Manager, Warehouse Clerk). The role defines which menu options are visible.
ayuda.maestros.cont: Creation and maintenance of the system's base data.
ayuda.productos.cont: Component CRUD (CPU, GPU, RAM, etc.). Create, change price and logical delete. Every change is recorded in 'Components - C'.
ayuda.clientes.cont: Customer CRUD. Validations for ID (8), email, phone (10). XML export/import.
ayuda.compC.cont: Component change log. Shows each component's history (versioned): Comp_Code, Date, Time, Name, Stock, Description and Act (current). Filter by code, name and date range. 'ACTIVATE' marks a version as current.
ayuda.proveedores.cont: Supplier registry (Tax ID, contact and bank details: CBU, Bank, Holder). Can be opened from here or as a step while building a quote request.
ayuda.carrito.cont: Select the customer and add components with their quantity. The system validates stock.
ayuda.facturar.cont: Generates the cart invoice and records the payment (cash or card with Luhn + CVV validation) in a single operation. Stock is deducted on payment.
ayuda.compras.cont: Stock replenishment: quotes, purchase orders, payment and receiving (RFN2).
ayuda.cotizaciones.cont: Create a quote request (QR) by choosing components and a supplier. If the supplier doesn't exist, register it from the same step.
ayuda.oc.cont: Create the purchase order from a QR: enter the quoted unit price and the delivery date. From here you can also pay the order with the 'Pay order' button.
ayuda.pago.cont: Records the payment to the supplier with their bank details. The receipt number is generated automatically. The order becomes 'Paid' and the receipt can be exported to PDF.
ayuda.recepcion.cont: The warehouse clerk records the quantity received of each component. Stock goes up and, if something is missing, the order becomes 'Received with shortages'.
ayuda.rep1.cont: Sales by period with date, customer and status filters. Exports to PDF.
ayuda.rep2.cont: Component reconciliation: purchase orders with ordered vs received, supplier and payment. Exports to PDF.
ayuda.rep3.cont: Sales strategy: turnover, days of inventory, urgent restock and dead stock. Includes a best-sellers chart and a bundle/promotion plan.
ayuda.usuarios.cont: Create, change, lock/unlock and activate users.
ayuda.perfiles.cont: Assignment of families and permissions to roles (Composite pattern).
ayuda.eventos.cont: Audit of the system's operations, with filters and PDF export.
ayuda.respaldos.cont: Database backup and restore. Automatic backups every 3 hours.
